notes:
1. 全面优化主页、扫描、游戏、备份、详情和设置界面，增加筛选、分页、状态反馈和高 DPI 自适应布局。
2. 修复确认弹窗“否”按钮看不清、短消息出现多余滚动条以及连续切换页面时侧栏文字消失的问题。
3. 新增应用 Logo，并同步用于侧栏、窗口和安装包图标。
4. 修复关闭“游戏退出后自动备份”后定时备份失效的问题；定时备份会在游戏运行期间按间隔执行，文件变动备份仍等待游戏退出。[#23](https://github.com/Kiowx/save_manager/issues/23)
5. 版本更新至 1.6.0。
6. Refresh the Home, Scan, Games, Backups, Details, and Settings views with filters, pagination, status feedback, and high-DPI responsive layouts.
7. Fix unreadable “No” buttons in confirmation dialogs, unnecessary scrollbars for short messages, and disappearing sidebar labels after repeated navigation.
8. Add a new app logo for the sidebar, window, and packaged executable.
9. Fix scheduled backups not running when “Back up after game exit” is disabled; scheduled backups now run at the configured interval while games are open, while file-change backups still wait for game exit. [#23](https://github.com/Kiowx/save_manager/issues/23)
10. Bump the version to 1.6.0.
